reason: My register has run this salon for years and I know every page of it. My stylists are busy with customers all day, and I don't see them stopping to take selfies and type numbers into an app for every walk-in.
objection: My staff won't type everything into an app when the chairs are full, so in two weeks I'll be paying ₹999 a month for an app nobody uses while the register carries on as before. And after losing two good stylists last year, I don't want to push something on the team that makes them feel watched.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running in another salon my size nearby, where the stylists actually use it on a busy Saturday and the owner shows me it caught missing cash or brought customers back.
